description: Ezoic Setup helps publishers and developers implement Ezoic ads on any site. Ask a question in plain language and it answers with working, copyable code grounded in Ezoic's official documentation, SDKs, and examples - ad placeholders, showAds calls, SPA route-change handling, consent (Gatekeeper) scripts, WordPress and Next.js/React integrations, ads.txt setup, and troubleshooting. It covers JavaScript, React, Vue, Angular, WordPress, and raw HTML sites, and always recommends the cleanest supported integration path for your stack. No account is required to ask questions.
